text_en: The senseless have vain and false hopes, and dreams give wings to fools.
text_cn: 愚人的希望，是虚幻而妄诞的；梦境使无知的人想入非非。

text_en: As one who catches at a shadow and pursues the wind, so is anyone who believes in dreams.
text_cn: 迷信幻梦的人，与捕风捉影的人无异；

text_en: What is seen in dreams is but a reflection, the likeness of a face looking at itself.
text_cn: 梦里看到的，与照镜所见的相同。

text_en: From an unclean thing what can be clean? And from something false what can be true?
text_cn: 污秽里能有什么洁净呢？虚伪中能有什么真实呢？

text_en: Divinations and omens and dreams are unreal, and like a woman in labor, the mind has fantasies.
text_cn: 占卜、算命、测梦，都是虚妄的；

text_en: Unless they are sent by intervention from the Most High, pay no attention to them.
text_cn: 人心如临产妇女的心，容易遭受幻想的袭击；梦境若不是出于至高者，你就不用介意；

text_en: For dreams have deceived many, and those who put their hope in them have perished.
text_cn: 因为，梦使许多人误入迷途，他们寄望于梦，却大失所望。

text_en: Without such deceptions the law will be fulfilled, and wisdom is complete in the mouth of the faithful.
text_cn: 履行法律，并不赖虚伪；出自忠信人口的智言，必见诸实行。

text_en: An educated person knows many things, and one with much experience knows what he is talking about.
text_cn: 没有受过考验的人，知道什么？旅行的人，知道的事情才多；经验多的人，富于思想；阅历深的人，谈吐明智；

text_en: An inexperienced person knows few things,
text_cn: 未受过考验的人，知道的少；但旅行的人，见闻很广。

text_en: but he that has traveled acquires much cleverness.
text_cn: 没有受过考验的人，知道什么？凡受过欺骗的人，必富于智巧。

text_en: I have seen many things in my travels, and I understand more than I can express.
text_cn: 我旅行时，见过许多事情，有好多事，我虽然明白，却不能用言语形容出来。

text_en: I have often been in danger of death, but have escaped because of these experiences.
text_cn: 我多次遇到死亡的危险，但赖天主的宠佑，凭着昔日的经验，我终能脱险获救。

text_en: The spirit of those who fear the Lord will live,
text_cn: 敬畏上主之人的精神必然常存，在上主回顾下，必蒙祝福；

text_en: for their hope is in him who saves them.
text_cn: 因为他们的希望指向拯救他们的主，天主的眼常注视爱慕他的人。

text_en: Those who fear the Lord will not be timid, or play the coward, for he is their hope.
text_cn: 敬畏上主的人，无所畏惧，无所恐怖，因为上主是他的希望。

text_en: Happy is the soul that fears the Lord!
text_cn: 敬畏上主的人，他的灵魂是有福的！

text_en: To whom does he look? And who is his support?
text_cn: 他所仰望的是谁？谁又是他的扶助？

text_en: The eyes of the Lord are on those who love him, a mighty shield and strong support, a shelter from scorching wind and a shade from noonday sun, a guard against stumbling and a help against falling.
text_cn: 上主的眼常注视爱慕他的人，他是大能的保障，是强有力的后盾，是隔除热气的屏风，是遮盖正午太阳的凉棚，

text_en: He lifts up the soul and makes the eyes sparkle; he gives health and life and blessing.
text_cn: 是失足时的护卫，是跌倒时的救援；他鼓舞精神，开明眼目，赐与健康、生命和幸福。

text_en: If one sacrifices ill-gotten goods, the offering is blemished;
text_cn: 奉献不义之财，乃是凌辱的祭品，恶人的供物，上主决不会悦纳。

text_en: the gifts of the lawless are not acceptable.
text_cn: 上主只善待那些在真理和正义的路上，期望他的人。

text_en: The Most High is not pleased with the offerings of the ungodly, nor for a multitude of sacrifices does he forgive sins.
text_cn: 至高者不悦纳不虔敬者的祭品，不垂顾恶人的献仪，决不因为他们的祭品多，而宽恕他们的罪恶。

text_en: Like one who kills a son before his father’s eyes is the person who offers a sacrifice from the property of the poor.
text_cn: 用穷人的财物来做祭品的人，就如在父亲前，杀害他儿子的人。

text_en: The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; whoever deprives them of it is a murderer.
text_cn: 贫乏人的粮食，是穷人的生命；夺取他们食粮的，就是流人血的罪犯。

text_en: To take away a neighbor’s living is to commit murder;
text_cn: 夺取别人由血汗赚来的食粮的，就是杀人的刽子手。

text_en: to deprive an employee of wages is to shed blood.
text_cn: 剥夺佣工的劳资的，就是流人血的凶手。

text_en: When one builds and another tears down, what do they gain but hard work?
text_cn: 一人建筑，一人拆毁，除劳苦外，为他们有什么好处！

text_en: When one prays and another curses, to whose voice will the Lord listen?
text_cn: 一人祈福，一人诅咒，天主究竟要俯听谁的呼声？

text_en: If one washes after touching a corpse, and touches it again, what has been gained by washing?
text_cn: 人摸了死尸就去沐浴，以后再去摸它，他的沐浴有什么用处？

text_en: So if one fasts for his sins, and goes again and does the same things, who will listen to his prayer? And what has he gained by humbling himself?
text_cn: 守斋赎罪，而再去犯罪的人，也是如此：有谁听他的祈求？他谦卑自下，又有什么益处？
